extDescription.message: Capture what you did and its impact from any page. Drafts open in your impact log — nothing is sent to a server.

fieldLinkHint.message: PR, issue, commit or doc — the type is detected automatically

selectionPlacement.message: Where to put the selected text

privacyNote.message: The draft goes in the link, not via a server.

errorTooLarge.message: Too long to fit in a link — shorten the description or the selected text.

optionsLead.message: The extension only prepares drafts. Your entries are stored and encrypted in impact log.

optionsAppUrlHint.message: Drafts open here. For local development: http://localhost:5173

optionsAppUrlInvalid.message: Use https://… (http:// only for localhost), without query, # or special characters in the address

optionsDefaultScoreHint.message: Preselected in the popup and used for context-menu captures.

privacyNoNetwork.message: The extension makes no network requests and collects no statistics. Drafts reach impact log inside the link fragment (after #), which browsers never send to servers.

permissionsTitle.message: Permissions and why they are needed

permActiveTab.message: activeTab — the title, address and selected text of the current tab, only after you click the extension or its menu item.

permScripting.message: scripting — read the selected text on that page at that moment. No scripts stay on pages.

permContextMenus.message: contextMenus — the “Save … to impact log” items in the right-click menu.

permStorage.message: storage — these settings (synced by Chrome) and an unsent popup draft (kept in memory until the browser is closed).
